description: Asks Met.no for weather.forecast_home every 10 minutes. The integration polls only about hourly, so when api.met.no returned 502/503 at 14:02 on 2026-11-04 the Show's weather stayed blank until the next poll; now an outage clears within 10 minutes. 144 requests a day is far below the 20 requests a second at which Met.no asks an app to contact them. Source: ha-dashboard/automations/weather_refresh.json
